text: OVERDOSAGE Amphotericin B overdoses can result in potentially fatal cardiac or cardiorespiratory arrest (see WARNINGS and DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION ). If an overdose is suspected, discontinue therapy and monitor the patient’s clinical status (e.g., cardiorespiratory, renal, and liver function, hematologic status, serum electrolytes) and administer supportive therapy, as required. Amphotericin B is not hemodialyzable. Prior to reinstituting therapy, the patient’s condition should be stabilized (including correction of electrolyte deficiencies, etc.).
